behaviors.label: Standing
behaviors.description: Upright adult with both webbed feet supporting the body, short visible ankles beneath the plumage, and flippers down beside the trunk.

behaviors.label: Swim
behaviors.description: The paired flippers sweep above and below the body while both feet trail. The active cycles use the 1.35 Hz dominant stroke frequency reported for seven emperor penguins. The eight-second sequence eases into a glide.
behaviors.evidence: Tag-based cadence and underwater film; authored pose and transition
behaviors.timeScale: Display seconds; active cadence referenced to emperor penguin tracking

rendering.reason: Evidence-informed visualization of external posture and motion. Joint angles, dimensions and hydrodynamics remain unvalidated.

behaviors.studyNote: The cadence is field-referenced. The phase timing, angles and travel are illustrative.

behaviors.label: Underwater glide
behaviors.description: The penguin holds a belly-down profile, holds the flippers slightly swept back and trails both webbed feet. The three-second study shows an example of a short passive glide with authored deceleration.
behaviors.evidence: Observed stroke-and-glide context; authored streamline pose
